newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes weaker in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes weaker in active trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar reversed early strength to close lower against its American counterpart on Tuesday on late U.S. dollar buying, dealers said.
The local unit finished at T$27.493 against Monday's T$27.489 close. Turnover was an active US$284 million.

U.S. dollar selling by exporters pushed the Taiwan dollar firmer in early trade. "But some local banks appeared to buy U.S. dollars in the afternoon, dragging the Taiwan dollar down," said one dealer. Despite an active trade, dealers said they did not expect major movements amid a lack of fresh market news. A T$27.48-50 range was seen for Wednesday. -Joyce Liu (2-5080815)
